description.value:
You channel a large volume of chakra to bring back a creature on the brink. If the target was reduced to 0 HP within the last minute and has not yet permanently died, restore them to half their maximum Hit Points and remove the dying condition entirely.

If the target is still conscious but injured, instead restore HP equal to 6d8 + your spellcasting modifier and remove one severe condition (any condition with value 2 or 3) by 1 step.

You become fatigued after casting this jutsu.

Heightened (8th) The window for bringing back a fallen ally extends to 10 minutes; the conscious-healing roll becomes 8d8.
